Exact MLPerf Tiny image-classification inference through a thin PyTorch adapter for the official ResNet8 model and CIFAR-10 accuracy set.

**Systems focus:** Convolution, tensor layout, batching, and accelerator utilization at a laptop- and classroom-friendly scale.
